hypothesis: Static bilateral interception alone accepts two contacts both pushing down from rounded pad tips. Require approximately opposing analytic capsule normals and contacts away from the lower rounded pad edge; include larger rolls that can change wall clearance without pushing through walls.
selection: Rank by offsets from 2mm approach, zero axial shift/roll and24mm opening. Separate convex CAD world uses only learned targets and fixed dimensions. Check centre plus six +/-1mm position and six +/-5degree axis sensitivity probes before sampled environment path clearance. Save first three ranked endpoint-IK checks and their chosen action list before any physics. The first feasible action is the primary selection; other saved actions are diagnostic probes, never replacements for a failed primary.
physics: Unchanged v7 free-capsule lift/transfer/hold dynamics and strict retention/contact scoring. Fixture held at checkpoint; no external force, attachment, teleport after restore, or new controller gains/friction. These rolls are not live-integrated.
scope: Three selected development states and a finite candidate family, not independent trials, certified force closure, complete placement, online freshness, calibrated uncertainty or novelty. Preserve abstentions and every physical failure.
